scientific_integrity: Analytic proof and exact rational computational cross-check. Established ingredients attributed to prior work. No independent validation or absolute priority certification.
scientific_limitations: The diameter bound is sufficient rather than sharp. The exact three-voter criterion concerns a specified nonspanning profile.
